creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_res = apis.spotify.login(username='caiburc@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login_res['access_token']

# current year from datetime.now()
current_year = datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# fetch all recommendations (paginated)
recommendations = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    recommendations.extend(res)
    page_index += 1

print('recommendations_total', len(recommendations))

# fetch details for each song and filter by release year and R&B genre
filtered = []
checks = []
for r in recommendations:
    sid = r['song_id']

        filtered.append(sid)

# also count how many are rnb regardless of year, and how many this year regardless of rnb

print('rnb_count', rnb_count, 'this_year_count', this_year_count)

from datetime import datetime

# Login to spotify
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_res = apis.spotify.login(username='caiburc@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login_res['access_token']

current_year = datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# Fetch all recommendations (paginated)
recommendations = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    recommendations.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
print('recommendations_total', len(recommendations))

# Filter: R&B + released in current_year
filtered_song_ids = []
seen = set()
for rec in recommendations:
    sid = rec['song_id']
    if sid in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(sid)
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date = song.get('release_date')
    release_year = int(str(release_date)[:4]) if release_date else None
    genre = (song.get('genre') or '').lower()

    is_rnb = (genre == 'r&b') or ('r&b' in genre) or ('rnb' in genre)
    # also look at artist genres if provided
    artist_genres = [a.get('genre') for a in song.get('artists', []) if a.get('genre')]
    artist_genres_lower = [g.lower() for g in artist_genres]
    is_rnb = is_rnb or any(('r&b' in g) or ('rnb' in g) for g in artist_genres_lower)

    if is_rnb and release_year == current_year:
        filtered_song_ids.append(sid)

print('filtered_count', len(filtered_song_ids))
print('filtered_song_ids', filtered_song_ids)

# Create playlist
create_res = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title='R&B Recommendation', access_token=access_token, is_public=False)
playlist_id = create_res['playlist_id']
print('created_playlist_id', playlist_id)

# Add songs to playlist
add_results = []
for sid in filtered_song_ids:
    res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
    add_results.append(res)

print('added_count', len(filtered_song_ids))
